_about: Exam for the choose role (picking the right edition among a book bot's options). The model gets the book and the numbered labels and returns {"index": n, "reason": "..."}; -1 means none of these is this book. Pass: every `right` is matched. Cases 1 to 5 are invented in a common style; cases 6 to 8 are the real bot's answers (pipeline ticket 05, probes 1 to 3), after the rule filter.
